description:
Hello, 

We are Team LEO, and we are a set of ambitious youth that are excited to combine our skills in STEM technology and coding to put together a very exciting project!
summary:
Why are the Mars Exploration Rovers so important? We chose to answer that and learn its complete mission before they retired. Upon discovery, we learned so much more about the rovers, from when they launched to how they died. 

We wanted to share how we learned the story of the rovers by making a 3D prop and Scratch game to learn and tell the story. Learning all about what the accomplishments of the mission were from Spirit and Opportunity was very important, as well as the timeline. We wanted to make it easy to learn the most important facts about the rovers, from launch until death. 

Now that the rovers are retired, we hope we can learn from their mission so others can improve the designs and obstacles for the new rovers in the future!
details:
We made a 3D diorama and game to learn and teach how the Mars Exploration Project Mission was operated. We made the 3D models using Tinkercad. After we made our props, we told the story of the rovers and how they entered Mars' atmosphere.

We also made a Scratch Game to show the mission step-by-step and what discoveries were made by each rover. Using some 3D models, we also added them as sprites for our game. We combined different mediums, Tinkercad, 3D modeling, and 3D printing to tell the story of the Mars Rovers.

Simply play "START" to play the game, and use the Arrows to go forward or wait for the cutscenes to end. The game will share interesting facts about the parts of the mission.

We originally wanted to make a 3D robot to tell the story of the rover. We also found that we needed to share the project with others and we wanted to make a game that everyone can play.
dataRefs: Mars Exploration Rovers: Spirit and Opportunity
